mapper.select: select c.id as courseId, c.course_no, c.course_name, c.user_id as teacher_id, u.user_no as teacher_no, u.name as teacher_name from course c left join user u on c.user_id = u.id ORDER BY c.id desc LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}
mapper.insert: insert into course_choice (id, user_id, course_id) values (#{id}, #{studentId}, #{courseId})
mapper.select: select cc.id as course_choice_id, cc.course_id, c.course_no, c.course_name, c.user_id as teacher_id, u.name as teacherName, u.user_no as teacherNo, true as chosen from course_choice cc inner join course c on cc.course_id = c.id left join user u on c.user_id = u.id where cc.user_id = #{studentId} order by cc.course_id desc

select count(*) from course c
AND c.course_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{courseName},'%')
